turns.question: What was our win rate on the search leads that came in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The lead-to-booking rate (the semantic layer's one definition of a lead's win or conversion) for search-channel leads created 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 was 33.7 %, i.e. the share of those leads that booked within 30 days of being created. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
